svg.title: Commit Activity × AI Collaboration — All time
svg.desc: Daily commit heatmap 2025-08-24 to 2026-08-23: 1788 commits, 1294 AI-assisted (72%), publishable repositories only. Intensity is total commits (the owner's own commits included); hue is the day's AI share. Generated 2026-08-26.
